name: WORKSPACE_PERMISSION_DENIED
title: Falcon is not allowed to use that folder
fix: Choose a folder you own (for example inside Documents), or change the folder permissions, then try again.

name: WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND
title: The workspace could not be found
fix: The folder may have been moved, renamed or deleted. Reopen Falcon, or choose the workspace folder again in Settings > Storage.

name: WORKSPACE_REVISION_CONFLICT
title: The workspace changed while you were working
fix: Reload the file list and repeat the action.

name: VAULT_LOCKED
title: The secure vault is locked
fix: Unlock Falcon with your vault password, then repeat the action.

name: VAULT_PASSWORD_INVALID
title: The vault password is wrong
fix: Check the password and try again. If it is lost, use the recovery key shown when the vault was created.

name: VAULT_RECOVERY_FAILED
title: The recovery key was not accepted
fix: Check the recovery key for typing mistakes (copy it exactly as it was shown). If it still fails, the vault cannot be opened and support must be contacted.

name: WORKSPACE_SCHEMA_TOO_NEW
title: This workspace was made by a newer Falcon
fix: Update Falcon to the latest version, then open the workspace again.

name: STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE
title: Falcon could not open its data folder or database
fix: Make sure the disk is not full or read-only and that security software is not blocking Falcon, then restart the app.

name: INSUFFICIENT_DISK_SPACE
title: There is not enough free disk space
fix: Free some space on the drive that holds Falcon's data and the output folder, then try again.

name: SOURCE_CHANGED_DURING_SNAPSHOT
title: The file changed while Falcon was reading it
fix: Close the file in other programs (Word, Excel, a PDF reader) and sync tools, then run the job again.

name: SOURCE_PASSWORD_REQUIRED
title: The file is password protected
fix: Remove the password in the program that created the file, or open it there and save an unprotected copy.

name: UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT
title: This file type is not supported
fix: Falcon translates PDF, DOCX and XLSX files. Convert the file to one of these formats first.

name: DOCUMENT_CORRUPT
title: The file is damaged or unreadable
fix: Open the file in its own program and save a fresh copy. If it will not open there either, the file is damaged.

name: DOCUMENT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED
title: The file is larger than Falcon can process
fix: Split the document into smaller parts (fewer pages or sheets) and translate them separately.

name: ARCHIVE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED
title: The file contains too much packed data
fix: The Office file expands to an unsafe size. Re-save it without large embedded objects, or split it.

name: ARCHIVE_PATH_UNSAFE
title: The file contains an unsafe internal path
fix: Falcon refused the file for safety. Re-save it from the original program; do not trust files from unknown sources.

name: DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND
title: The document is not ready or does not exist
fix: Wait for the job to finish parsing the file, then try again. If the job failed, run it again.

name: DOCUMENT_REVISION_CONFLICT
title: The document changed since you opened it
fix: Reload the document in Compare and repeat your edit.

name: JOB_STATE_CONFLICT
title: The job cannot do that right now
fix: Wait for the job to reach a stable state (running, paused or finished), then try again.

name: JOB_NOT_FOUND
title: The job could not be found
fix: It may have been deleted. Refresh the job list.

name: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT
title: The same request was sent twice with different settings
fix: Repeat the action from the beginning.

name: BATCH_ALL_OR_NOTHING_BLOCKED
title: A batch was stopped because some files cannot be translated
fix: Remove the files that failed the check, or turn off the all-or-nothing option, then start the batch again.

name: LANGUAGE_AMBIGUOUS
title: Falcon could not tell the source language
fix: Pick the source language yourself in the Translate dialog.

name: MEMORY_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND
title: The translation memory entry was not found
fix: It may have been deleted. Refresh the Memory page.

name: TERM_SET_NOT_FOUND
title: The terminology set was not found
fix: It may have been deleted. Refresh the Terminology page.

name: TERMINOLOGY_CONFLICT
title: Two glossary terms contradict each other
fix: Open Terminology and remove or change one of the conflicting entries.

name: TRANSLATED_UNIT_NOT_FOUND
title: That segment no longer exists
fix: Reload the document in Compare.

name: REVIEW_NOTHING_TO_REJECT
title: There is no unapproved edit to discard
fix: Nothing to do; the segment already matches its approved text.

name: REVISION_NOT_FOUND
title: That earlier version was not found
fix: Reload the revision history and pick another version.

name: JOB_INTERRUPTED
title: Falcon was closed while this job was running
fix: Press Retry on the job. Nothing was lost; it starts again from the beginning.

name: MODEL_NOT_INSTALLED
title: A translation model is missing
fix: Open Settings > Models and install the language pack, or check the internet connection and retry the download.

name: MODEL_INCOMPATIBLE
title: The installed model does not match this Falcon
fix: Reinstall the model pack from Settings > Models, or update Falcon.

name: MODEL_CHECKSUM_FAILED
title: A downloaded model file is damaged
fix: Delete the pack in Settings > Models and download it again. Repeated failures usually mean an unstable connection or a proxy altering the download.

name: MODEL_OUT_OF_MEMORY
title: The computer ran out of memory while translating
fix: Close other programs, translate fewer pages at a time, and retry. 16 GB of RAM is recommended for large documents.

name: MODEL_MEMORY_BUDGET_EXCEEDED
title: Not enough free memory to start translating
fix: Close other programs and retry. Other jobs may be using the memory; wait for them to finish.

name: GPU_DRIVER_UNSUPPORTED
title: The graphics driver is not supported
fix: Update the graphics driver, or turn off GPU use; Falcon works on the CPU alone.

name: TRANSLATION_FAILED
title: Translation failed
fix: Retry the job. If it fails again, send a diagnostics bundle from Settings > Diagnostics.

name: TRANSLATION_STRUCTURE_INVALID
title: The translation broke the document structure
fix: Retry the segment from Compare, or edit it by hand.

name: TRANSLATION_ALIGNMENT_FAILED
title: The translated text could not be matched to the original
fix: Retry the segment from Compare, or edit it by hand.

name: PLACEHOLDER_RESTORE_FAILED
title: Numbers, names or formatting could not be restored
fix: Review the highlighted segments in Compare and correct them by hand.

name: VALIDATION_BLOCKED_OUTPUT
title: The result failed Falcon's quality checks
fix: Open Compare, fix the flagged segments, then export again.

name: DEVICE_BELOW_RECOMMENDED_MEMORY
title: This computer has less memory than recommended
fix: Falcon still works but is slower and may split large files. 16 GB of RAM is recommended.

name: LLAMA_CLI_DOWNLOAD_FAILED
title: The helper program could not be downloaded
fix: Check the internet connection and retry from Settings > Models.

name: OCR_FAILED
title: Scanned text could not be read
fix: Check that the OCR models are installed (Settings > Models) and that the scan is sharp and upright, then retry.

name: LAYOUT_OVERFLOW_REQUIRES_REVIEW
title: Translated text does not fit the original layout
fix: Open Compare and shorten the flagged segments, or choose a layout that allows text to grow.

name: RECONSTRUCTION_FAILED
title: The translated file could not be built
fix: Retry the export. If it fails again, send a diagnostics bundle from Settings > Diagnostics.

name: OUTPUT_COLLISION_REQUIRES_INPUT
title: A file with that name already exists
fix: Choose a different name or folder, or confirm replacing the existing file.

name: OUTPUT_PROTECTION_UNAVAILABLE
title: The output could not be protected as requested
fix: Turn off output protection or fix the vault state, then export again.

name: OUTPUT_VERIFY_FAILED
title: The exported file failed its safety check
fix: Export again. The file was not saved; if it keeps failing, send a diagnostics bundle.

name: SIGNATURE_PLACEMENT_INVALID
title: The stamp position is not on the page
fix: Move the stamp box inside the page and place it again.

name: SIGNATURE_IMAGE_INVALID
title: The signature stamp image could not be read
fix: Use a PNG or JPEG image that opens in an image viewer.

name: SIGNATURE_NAME_INVALID
title: The signer name is empty or too long
fix: Enter a shorter name.

name: COMPANY_ASSET_NOT_FOUND
title: The company seal or logo has not been uploaded
fix: Upload the company seal or logo in the Stamp dialog first, then stamp again.

name: WATERMARK_INVALID
title: The watermark settings are not valid
fix: Use short text, opacity between 0 and 100 percent and a rotation within range.

name: WATERMARK_NOT_FOUND
title: There is no Falcon watermark to remove
fix: Nothing to do; the document carries no Falcon watermark.

name: PLACED_ASSET_NOT_FOUND
title: That stamp is not a Falcon-placed item
fix: Only signature stamps, seals and logos placed by Falcon can be removed.

name: OPTIMIZE_PROFILE_INVALID
title: The optimize setting is unknown
fix: Pick one of the listed optimize profiles.

name: PAGE_SETUP_INVALID
title: The page size settings are not valid
fix: Enter a valid page size and page range.

name: PAGE_SETUP_NOT_FOUND
title: Those pages were never resized by Falcon
fix: Nothing to reset.

name: PROTECT_PASSWORD_INVALID
title: The PDF password is not acceptable
fix: Use a password of 8 to 128 characters that is not blank.

name: CONVERT_UNSUPPORTED
title: That conversion is not supported
fix: Falcon converts between PDF and DOCX only. Check the source file is not empty.

name: DOCUMENT_ALREADY_PROTECTED
title: The PDF is already password protected
fix: Remove the existing password first.

name: FEATURE_NOT_LICENSED
title: This feature needs a license
fix: Activate a license in Settings > License.

name: LICENSE_INVALID
title: The license file is not valid
fix: Use the original license file you received. If it was edited or truncated, request a new copy.

name: SIDECAR_UNAVAILABLE
title: A Falcon helper program is not running
fix: Restart Falcon. If it persists, reinstall Falcon; security software may be blocking the helper.

name: SIDECAR_CRASH_LOOP
title: A Falcon helper program keeps crashing
fix: Restart the computer, free memory, and retry. Send a diagnostics bundle if it continues.

name: SIDECAR_PROTOCOL_MISMATCH
title: A Falcon helper program is the wrong version
fix: Reinstall Falcon so that all parts are the same version.

name: SECURITY_POLICY_VIOLATION
title: Falcon blocked an unsafe action
fix: No action is needed. If you did not expect this, send a diagnostics bundle.

name: INTERNAL_ERROR
title: Falcon hit an unexpected problem
fix: Restart Falcon and repeat the action. If it happens again, open Settings > Diagnostics, create a diagnostics bundle and send it to support.

name: NOT_IMPLEMENTED
title: This action is not available yet
fix: Update Falcon. If the problem remains, tell support which action you used.
